body:
routed_int4_launch(
        static_cast<uint32_t>(blocks),
        // Submit queued Torch producers before this direct runtime launch.
        c10_npu::getCurrentNPUStream().stream(),
        static_cast<uint64_t>(sync_base), rows.data_ptr(), gate_up.data_ptr(),
        gu_bias.data_ptr<float>(), reinterpret_cast<ScaleStorage*>(gu_scale.data_ptr()),
        down.data_ptr(), down_bias.data_ptr<float>(),
        reinterpret_cast<ScaleStorage*>(down_scale.data_ptr()),
        token_scale.data_ptr<float>(), group_count.data_ptr(),
        group_start.data_ptr(), source_row.data_ptr(), source_slot.data_ptr(),
        row_weight.data_ptr<float>(), scratch[kStacked].data_ptr(),
        scratch[kGateProduct].data_ptr(), scratch[kMiddle].data_ptr(),
        scratch[kMiddleScale].data_ptr<float>(), scratch[kDownProduct].data_ptr(),
        scratch[kRouteOutput].data_ptr(), scratch[kOutput].data_ptr(),
        scratch[kGateTiling].data_ptr(), scratch[kDownTiling].data_ptr(),
        scratch[kMatmulWorkspace].data_ptr(), experts, tokens, weight_layout,
        dispatch
#ifdef ROUTED_SHARED_PIPELINE
        , shared
#endif
        );
